inicio.titulo_pagina: SIGAB · Your farm in your pocket
inicio.saludo: For cattle, pig, poultry, fish farms and more
inicio.titulo: Your farm, in the palm of your
inicio.lead: Know how your animals are doing, find out in time when something is wrong and keep your accounts clear. All from your phone, even when the signal comes and goes.
inicio.nota_instalar: Installs on your phone like any app.
inicio.escena_aria: Phone with SIGAB open: the farm is fine, with 128 animals and an alert that the pen is very hot
inicio.aviso_calor_detalle: 31 °C. Check the shade and the water.
inicio.aviso_senal_detalle: What you wrote offline was saved.

beneficios.titulo: Less notebook, fewer scares and more time for yourself
beneficios.animal_detalle: Its weight, its vaccines, what it eats and how it has grown, without digging through papers.
beneficios.avisos_detalle: If the poultry house gets too hot or the pond water is not right, you get an alert on your phone.
beneficios.salud_detalle: The system tells you which animals could get sick so the veterinarian arrives sooner.
beneficios.cuentas_detalle: How much you spend, how much your animals are worth and reports ready for the accountant.

campo.titulo: No signal in the pasture? No problem
campo.texto: Write down what you need even without internet. When the signal comes back, SIGAB saves it on its own.
campo.celular_y_computador: Works on your phone and on your computer.
campo.modo_oscuro: Dark mode for use at night.

personas.texto: When you sign in, SIGAB shows you what you need for your job on the farm.
personas.dueno_titulo: If you are the owner or manager
personas.dueno_detalle: A traffic light tells you in seconds whether everything is fine or something needs your attention.
personas.veterinario_detalle: See which animals are at risk and each one's history on a single screen.
personas.contador_pregunta: “How much is what we have worth?”
personas.contador_detalle: The value of the animals and the monthly reports, ready to download.

final.texto: Create your account, register your farm and in a few minutes you have your animals at hand.

inicio.pie_universidad: Made at Universidad Surcolombiana · Neiva, Huila
